name: MCP TypeScript SDK
prompt:
In this folder, set up a small Node.js project (ES modules) with the official Model Context Protocol TypeScript SDK and Zod. Create `solution.mjs` that exports `createServer()`, which returns an MCP server (named "calc", version "1.0.0") that is not yet connected to any transport, with:

1. A tool `add` that takes two numbers `a` and `b` (validated with Zod) and returns the sum as a text result, e.g. "5".
2. A resource at URI `config://app` that returns the JSON text `{"name":"calc"}` with mime type `application/json`.

Also add a `server.mjs` that connects `createServer()` to stdio so it can be used from Claude Desktop. Install the dependencies with npm.
